integrity: The proof is an algebraic elimination from the cited threshold equations. A bundled exact-rational checker verifies a representative parameter instance; the general proof does not rely on numerical sampling.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is exact for the reduced fast-variable threshold algebra of the cited model, not for all finite-seed trajectories of the unreduced ODE system. It assumes \(R_0>1\), \(n>2\), and coverage above the pure-triplewise feasibility threshold.
title: Exact quadratic synergy law for combined pairwise and triplewise contact tracing
